I found that the Slime Heart Seeds' price is 1000G,and a single Slime Heart just bring us 600-1000G (no star to gold star),which means we plant Slime Heart with income deficit.So now the price is reduced to 300G!（ Carambola seed is 400g so i think it is reasonable.)
Still asking for The original creator‘s permission

依旧寻求原作者的授权
